simple.meaning: הַרְמוֹן (harmôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “a castle (from its height).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

definitions.full: H2038. Harmon [ הַרְמוֺן ] noun masculine meaning dubious; text perhaps corrupt; only Amos 4:3 הַהַרְמ֫וֺנָה וְהִשְׁלַכְתֶּנָֿה and ye shall cast them (your אחרית , posterity, AE; Hi RV cast [yourselves], but read rather with Vrss as passive ׳וְהָשְׁל shall be cast ) into Harmon ; if text be sound, some locality must be meant, though the nature of the allusion is lost (AV, into the palace , treats הרמון improbable as = ארמון ). ᵑ6 ᵑ7 have mountain ( s ) of Armenia ( מוֺנָה הַר ), Symm Armenia , compare Lag Ges. Abh. 172 , Hoffm ZAW iii. 1882, 102, of exile ; Hi-St for ׳ה read הֲדַדְרִמּוֺנָה to Hadadrimmon , proper name, of a location in plain of Jezreel, so Gunning; ᵐ5 εἰς τὸ ὄρος τὸ Ῥομμαν , whence Ew ingeniously רמונה ההר and ye shall cast Rimmonah (name of idol, supposed feminine of Rimmon 2Kin 5:18 ) to the mountains. הָרַמִּים see אֲרַמִּי above
